system.description:
Lore: Relic Crystal (Bound)

A shard of Netherese thought-crystal, humming faintly with the residue of a mind that stopped using it a very long time ago.

Bound Effect: Grants Telepathy for as long as you remain Bound to it, and glows with a soft purple light while worn.

It has the following Powers:

  • Telepathy: Telepathy (Far) while you remain Bound to it. The crystal glows a soft purple while worn.

Value: 10000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
